description: §19.16.4 — `defer` is legal in a pure `fn`, but the deferred body is subject to every §48.3 prohibition as if written at each exit: a deferred reactive write `defer @n = 5` in a `fn` is E-FN-003. The `defer` itself is not the violation (no E-DEFER-* fires).
rationale: §19.16.4: `defer` is control flow, not an effect, so it is legal in `fn`; the deferred body is an ordinary part of the `fn` body and a deferred outer-state mutation is E-FN-003 (§48.3.3).
